title: Funding grants for new research into AI and teen development
summary: Apply now for OpenAI’s $5 million grant program supporting independent research on how generative AI affects teen development, well-being, and safety.
reason: This is a call for grant applications for research funding, not a research paper, technical report, or benchmark result (R2). It is not a model release (R1), industry financing/M&A/partnership/product launch (R3), policy event (R4), or OSS/tool release (R5). No active rule covers it.
